The docs (CONTRACT §who.matt, AGENTS.md, PLAN.md, MATT.md) describe this build's roles to its agents and stay as they are; renaming them is a repo instruction change for Matt. Drift risk: new code copies the name from the docs; the ESLint rule stops it. Cost: four contained tasks, mostly renames.

title: wouter is the app's one router, used only in the shell; screens never move between screens on their own
why: Problem: Back and Forward do not work. shell/App.tsx keeps the screen in React state and calls history.pushState, and nothing listens for popstate, so Back changes the address but not the screen; five area files read window.location.search by hand. Matt expects more views, so routes with params (for example a set or a note by id) and ?open= are a real need. Choice: wouter (small, tested, React hooks over the History API, no data-router layer) replaces the hand-written routing in the shell. Same rule as Radix in the kit (§ui.mockup): a tested library carries the hard behaviour. Second way considered: our own History API hook of about 30 lines; rejected because route params, nested routes and edge cases would grow by hand as views are added. Drift guard: only shell/ may import wouter (a dependency-cruiser rule); screens get their address and a navigate function from the shell as props, and ESLint refuses window.location and window.history in areas/, so there is one way to move between screens. Version pinned exactly (§drift.tools). Long-term cost: one small dependency; knip fails it if unused. Matt leaned to wouter and asked the build manager for the verdict; build manager decision.

title: Data layer: one Zod shape per kind in domain/, one write gate in data/, job output from the stored shape, no new data library
why: ev4's failures ('/plan: expected object, got string', 'malformed, so I binned it') came from shapes defined in seven places, no structured output on the plan job and a second practice generator that parsed plain text. v5 already sends a schema to the model, but the practice job's item shape has no id and a free sourceRef while domain/set requires both, plans have four shapes, jobs/runtime/d1-stores.ts holds its own SQL and writes are checked only in tests. So: each stored kind has one Zod row shape in domain/; data/ holds the only SQL and one gate that parses, applies domain rules, checks size and the protocol, and refuses with a reason (409 only when stale); reads are parsed and bad rows are reported, not shown; a job's output schema is derived from the domain row shape and sent through the Anthropic SDK's zodOutputFormat helper, replacing the hand-rolled strip(). No ORM: Drizzle 1.0 is still a release candidate and its transaction() fails on D1, Prisma's D1 support is Preview, kysely-d1 has no batch. Revisit Drizzle after a stable 1.0, as its own decision. A PRAGMA table_info test holds migrations and row shapes together.
source: D-483/D-484 (data-layer study 2026-11-05, audits/2026-11-05-data-v2/report.md in the ev-build project folder)

title: The kit leads every screen: Row variants, Page, Section and Empty patterns, Dot and Meter, and the shell's Detail host; each area's own copy is deleted when it moves
why: Audit finding 7 (checked): area CSS (1,102 lines) is as big as the kit's (1,152); six areas rebuild 'row plus action' because kit Row has only glyph, title, meta and value; row actions are always visible against §ui.lists; there is no page head, section or empty pattern, so section gaps are 48, 24 or 0 px against §ui.grid; the shell's Detail host is never fed, so Today and Library overlay their own Detail; Segmented is built but not exported; StudyCard is used nowhere. Plan: (1) kit/components: Dot (status tones from tokens, §ui.status), Meter (the mock-up's segmented 4 px bar), Segmented exported. (2) Row gains an actions slot shown only on hover, focus or right-click, onMenu for the kit Menu, a status dot, a done state, a folding variant (chevron, level, arrow keys) and a two-cell editor row; its current props stay, so nothing breaks while areas move. (3) kit/patterns: Page (title, meta, crumb, actions), Section (label head, quiet add action on hover, 48 px between sections) and Empty (quiet line plus one action), each with its /kit story and test, matching design/mockup.html. (4) The shell renders the one Detail panel beside the column from a new area-view prop; areas stop drawing Detail. (5) One task per area moves onto these parts and deletes its own row, head, section, empty and Detail CSS and markup in the same PR, so no second way survives; Today also drops its glyph colours (§ui.glyphs) and sessions move onto StudyCard. (6) A check then refuses area CSS that redraws a kit part. No CONTRACT rule changes: §ui.kit-leads, §ui.lists, §ui.grid, §ui.status and §ui.first-set ('added when an area needs it') already ask for this. No new dependency. Second way considered: per-area wrappers over kit Row; rejected, because it keeps the copies the audit counted. Drift risk: an area keeps a local look during its move; the per-area task deletes the copy and the guard check stops new ones. Cost: about 15 tasks, each under 400 lines; it runs after the audit's small fixes (B-958 tokens first) and before the post-cutover features, which are mostly lists and pages. Left out on purpose: the shared exam Detail content between Today and Library (proposal H, finding 10) and the two extra note renderers (editor work). Build manager decision on Matt's go-ahead.

Attempt-first: on a study question the system prompt makes E.V. ask for his attempt before explaining, insist once with a reason, then answer; ask.just_tell_me skips it and is logged (§ui.attempt-first, §ev.voice). why: Matt asked for a critical review: limits should be only what an agent can't undo. Canvas mechanism, same Worker and models-from-docs became ordinary rules; synthetic-outside-repo narrowed to §sec.live-data; nothing-outside-repo-deleted folded into §hard.data-never-lost and §deliver.cleanup. This is Matt's yes for Gate 0.
